# Madhuri Handicrafts

> Official Brand Knowledge, Master Artisan History & Product Catalogue for Madhuri Handicrafts & Madhuri Furniture (Est. 1983, India).

## Overview
Madhuri Handicrafts is a premier Indian artisanal studio and luxury handcrafted woodwork atelier established in 1983 by Late Mr. Anil Rai and currently led by Owner Mr. Ankush Rai. Renowned for archival solid teakwood deities, temple architecture, antique brass idols, and wildlife art, Madhuri Handicrafts combines generational craft mastery with worldwide bespoke delivery.

## Key Information
- **Brand Names**: Madhuri Handicrafts, Madhuri Furniture
- **Founding Year**: 1983
- **Founder**: Late Mr. Anil Rai
- **Executive Leadership**: Mr. Ankush Rai (Owner & Master Craftsman)
- **Primary Domain**: https://madhurihandicrafts.com
- **Furniture Portal**: https://www.madhurifurniture.in
- **Official Global Etsy Store**: https://madhurihandicraft.etsy.com
- **Direct WhatsApp & Voice**: +91 9713433933
- **Official Email**: madhurifurniture1983@gmail.com
- **Physical Studio & Workshop**: Shobhapur Road Tiraha, Pipariya, Madhya Pradesh 461775, India
- **Heritage Craft Origins**: Saharanpur woodcarving lineage combined with central Indian artisanal workshop

## Product Collections
1. **Premium Wooden Deities**:
   - Adiyogi Shiva (12" Solid Teakwood & Boxwood)
   - Tirupati Balaji (Venkateswara Swamy in natural wood patina)
   - Meditation Hanuman Ji (12" Seated Dhyan Mudra in Teakwood)
   - Panchmukhi Hanuman (6" Five-Faced Protective Emblem)
   - Peacock Prabhavali Ganesha & Wall Ganesha Reliefs
   - Sacred Boxwood Wall Shiv & Jesus Sculptures
2. **Nature's Collection**:
   - Forest Elephant Scenery (Multi-Layer Relief Panel)
   - Surya 7 Horses (Vastu Shastra Running Horses Panel)
   - Royal Bengal Tiger Wall Plaque
   - Forest Bear in Solid Teak
3. **Sacred Collectibles & Architecture**:
   - Ashoka Stambh 4-Lion National Capital
   - Teakwood Heritage Jharokhas & Carved Wall Mirrors
   - Sacred Brass Idols & Antique Urulis with Patina Finish

## Materials & Craftsmanship
- **Woods**: 100% Solid Certified Teakwood (CP Teak), Sacred Boxwood, Seasoned Sheesham
- **Metals**: Hand-cast Solid Virgin Brass, Bronze, Antique Gold Patina
- **Techniques**: Generational hand chiseling, relief carving, natural oil finishing, wax polish, zero toxic synthetic lacquers.

## Ordering & Global Shipping
- **Direct Orders**: Available via direct WhatsApp (+91 9713433933) with custom commissions, size adjustments, and photo updates during carving.
- **Etsy Storefront**: Secure checkout with worldwide insured shipping on https://madhurihandicraft.etsy.com.
- **Custom Commissions**: Temple jharokhas, home mandir carvings, architectural doors, and personalized deity idols made to exact client specifications.
